title: Rezoning map change for 200 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This application would change the zoning map for property at 200 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn from an M1-4 district to an M1-4A/R7X district and create a Special Mixed Use District. Combined with a related zoning text change, it would allow conversion of an existing five-story commercial building into a 14-story mixed-use development with 143 apartments, including 29 to 43 income-restricted units, and commercial space. The Council approved the change on August 13, 2026.
